product.title: Half Day Shelling Dolphin Eco Tour in 10 000 Island and Marco

description.text: A small-group tour that offers a more intimate experience, this trip takes you on a half-day shelling and dolphin tour in Ten Thousand Islands and Marco. Join staff from a top shelling company in Florida and hop aboard a specially designed boat to navigate shallow waters in search of the best shells. Plus, you get the chance to spot the dolphins that inhabit the waters.Small-group tour: Skip large tour groups for a more personal experience Bottled water is included to keep you hydrated and refreshed Snap photos of dolphins and hunt for beautiful shells Learn more about the area and the wildlif Ideal for Naples and Marco Island visitors who want shallow-water shelling, dolphin watching, and mangrove-lined routes without chartering a boat alone.
